wooden_planks.name: Wooden Planks
wooden_planks.description: Free 8K texture of dry, worn wooden planks, even flat boards with subtle cracks, knots and narrow gaps, showing a soft, matte wood grain.

wooden_rough_planks.name: Wooden Rough Planks
wooden_rough_planks.description: Free 8K texture of rough, moss-covered round wooden planks: weathered, uneven surface with scratches, grain, and a damp green patina.

worn_planks.name: Worn Planks
worn_planks.description: Free 8K texture of worn wooden planks with peeling paint, deep cracks, rough grain and varied faded tones with rustic weathering.

yellow_plaster_02.name: Yellow Plaster 02
yellow_plaster_02.description: Free 8K texture of weathered yellow plaster over wooden planks with deep cracks, rough uneven mud-like surface and tan-brown tones.
